title: 第十二章 阿笠博士选择了中立
slug: 米花大舞台开局扮演工藤新一
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

渚琰·工藤新一回到卧室，选了一套原版工藤新一的衣服换上，然后把高木警官借给他的衣服拿到洗衣房去，路上发现小兰站在卫生间门口，却好像在发呆。

小兰发现自己收拾行李的时候少拿了些东西——像洗面奶、毛巾、牙刷、漱口杯这样的洗漱用具。

当然，这只是个小问题，解决方法有很多。

比如再回家一趟取，但如果回家时遇到毛利小五郎，当老爸的肯定会喋喋不休，而小兰自己也很不好意思。

工藤家里当然也备有给客人使用的一次性毛巾、牙刷等，但拿来用的话小兰有种说不清的变扭。

或者还可以再买一套，只是习惯了节俭的小兰觉得这样有些浪费。

“我觉得还是再买一套吧。”背后又传来了新一的声音：“从医院回来的路上去一下百货超市，怎么样？”

“呀！”背后的声音把小兰吓了一跳，回过头来看到是工藤新一，又想起刚刚打电话时的情景，后退两步躲到了卫生间里：“你刚刚说什么？”

“小兰不是在发愁牙刷一类的东西怎么办吗？”工藤新一满脸坦荡，好像不记得发生过什么事一样：“我支持再买一套的方案。”

“新一怎么知道的！”被说中心事，小兰有点吃惊。

“小兰在想什么，我一看就明白了哦。”工藤新一竖起一根手指摇了摇：“小兰看着卫生间发呆，但卫生间里没有摆放小兰的洗漱用品，那肯定就是忘了带。接着小兰一会往左上方看，一会往右上方看，有时还往下看，那就说明小兰心里大概有三个解决方案，只是哪一个都不满意。”

这当然也是实话，这种事情又无法通过对剧情的知悉来了解，确实是通过观察和头脑来推理出来的。

【滴——！】

系统警告又一次出现，吓了渚琰一跳，以为这破系统又算他说谎。

【做出不符合工藤新一的行为，扮演度下降0.5%】

【提示，工藤新一是猜不中毛利兰心事的。】

渚琰：……人在无语的时候真的会笑吗？

仔细一想，我都已经猜中了，还要为了人设故意猜不中，那不又成谎言了吗？看来金色评级的角色卡确实有难度。

顺带，渚琰调出关于隐藏挑战的面板确认了一下，现在是一排绿灯，原来的那个红灯已经被十句真话顶掉了。

这边，工藤新一和小兰来到玄关，换鞋时柯南又冒出来碍事了，从走廊探出头：“你们是要出门吗？”

看到冒牌工藤新一换上了他的衣服，柯南的眼角忍不住抽了一下：这家伙不仅用他的脸、住他的房子，还穿他的衣服、骚扰他的青梅竹马。

“新一要去检查一下身体，姐姐陪他去医院。”小兰回头解释道。

工藤新一一脸不耐烦：“你在家看家，不要出去乱跑。”

这家伙还敢去医院？柯南意外极了，这简直是天上掉馅饼的好事，去了医院这家伙一定会暴露破绽的！“我也要去！”

于是三人一起出了门。

刚出门，就看到了一个胖乎乎的小老头，从工藤宅隔壁的院子走了出来。

“阿笠博士！”小兰打招呼。

阿笠博士才刚刚起床，正要出门吃顿早午合一饭。

“小兰？……新一！？”阿笠博士本来是意外小兰又到了这边来，结果一扭头看到了小兰身边的工藤新一，十分甚至九分的吃惊。

难道新一吃的毒药效果是临时性的，被小兰领回去后不久就变回来了？

刚想要这么猜测，阿笠博士一低头，发现了两人身后还跟着一个‘柯南’。

这是咋回事？为什么既有新一，又有柯南？

阿笠博士的脑海里‘嘭’的炸开一团云雾，乱糟糟的，连小兰对他又说了什么都没听清。

等到阿笠博士整理好思绪后，用审视责问的目光看向了柯南。

Page (1/3)

Nagisa Kudo Shinichi returned to the bedroom, chose a set of original Kudo Shinichi's clothes and changed into them. Then he took the clothes that Officer Takagi lent him to the laundry room. On the way, he found Xiaolan standing at the door of the bathroom, but she seemed to be in a daze.

Xiaolan found that she had missed some things when packing her luggage - toiletries such as facial cleanser, towels, toothbrushes, and mouthwash cups.

Of course, this is just a small problem and there are many solutions.

For example, if you go home to pick it up again, but if you meet Mouri Kogoro when you go home, the father will definitely chatter endlessly, and Xiaolan herself will be very embarrassed.

Of course, Kudo's house also has disposable towels, toothbrushes, etc. for guests, but Xiaolan feels inexplicably weird when using them.

Or you can buy another set, but Xiaolan, who is used to being thrifty, thinks this is a bit wasteful.

"I think it's better to buy another set." Shinichi's voice came from behind again: "How about we go to a department store on the way back from the hospital?"

"Yeah!" The voice behind her startled Xiaolan. She turned around and saw that it was Kudo Shinichi. Then she remembered the scene when she was on the phone. She took two steps back and hid in the bathroom: "What did you just say?"

"Isn't Xiaolan worried about what to do with things like toothbrushes?" Kudo Shinichi said with a magnanimous face, as if he didn't remember what happened: "I support the plan of buying another set."

"How did Shinichi know!" Xiaolan was a little surprised to be told the central issue.

"I can understand what Xiaolan is thinking at a glance." Kudo Shinichi raised a finger and shook it: "Xiaolan looked at the bathroom in a daze, but there are no Xiaolan's toiletries in the bathroom, so she must have forgotten to bring them. Then Xiaolan looked to the upper left, sometimes to the upper right, and sometimes looked down, which means Xiaolan had about three solutions in mind, but she was not satisfied with any of them."

This is of course true. This kind of thing cannot be understood through knowledge of the plot. It can indeed be deduced through observation and brain.

【drop--!】

The system warning appeared again, which startled Zhuyan, thinking that this broken system meant that he was lying again.

[If you do something that is not in line with Kudo Shinichi, your performance will be reduced by 0.5%]

[Reminder, Kudo Shinichi cannot guess what Mao Lilan is thinking.】

Zhuyan: ...Do people really laugh when they are speechless?

Thinking about it carefully, I already guessed it correctly, and if I deliberately failed to guess it for the sake of character, wouldn’t that become a lie again?It seems that gold-rated character cards are indeed difficult.

By the way, Zhu Yan brought up the panel about hidden challenges to confirm. There was now a row of green lights, and the original red light had been replaced by ten truths.

Here, Kudo Shinichi and Xiaolan came to the entrance. When changing shoes, Conan appeared again and got in the way. He stuck his head out of the corridor: "Are you going out?"

Seeing the fake Kudo Shinichi put on his clothes, Conan couldn't help but twitch at the corner of his eyes: This guy not only used his face and lived in his house, but also wore his clothes and harassed his childhood sweetheart.

"Xinyi is going to have a physical check-up, and my sister will accompany him to the hospital." Xiaolan turned around and explained.

Kudo Shinichi looked impatient: "You stay at home and look after the house, don't go out and run around."

This guy still dares to go to the hospital?Conan was so surprised. This was a piece of cake. If he went to the hospital, his flaws would definitely be exposed!"I want to go too!"

So the three of them went out together.

As soon as I went out, I saw a chubby little old man walking out of the yard next to Kudo's house.

"Dr. Ali!" Xiaolan greeted.

Dr. A Li had just gotten up and was about to go out for breakfast and lunch.

"Xiaolan?...Shinichi!?" Dr. Ali was surprised that Xiaolan came here again, but when he turned around and saw Kudo Shinichi next to Xiaolan, he was very surprised or even 90% surprised.

Could it be that the effect of the poison taken by Shinichi was temporary and that he changed back soon after being taken back by Xiaolan?

Just when he was about to make such a guess, Dr. Ali lowered his head and discovered that there was a 'Conan' following the two of them.

What's going on?Why is there both Shinichi and Conan?

A cloud of fog exploded in Dr. A Li's mind, and it was so chaotic that he couldn't even hear clearly what Xiaolan said to him.

After Dr. A Li gathered his thoughts, he looked at Conan with a questioning look.
